sections.title: Drivers
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Fleet > Drivers

**Access rights:** Users with Master Data management rights

Use the path above to open the screen where you view the driver list.

![](/uploads/9cb6e94b4ce160b37f28ec52.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click a driver to view their details.

![](/uploads/3c2fcf1a2dacde7e897ad064.png)

### Step 2

Enter the driver information.

![](/uploads/27a99bcace24f463514ea2cf.png)

**General information [1]**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Driver name | Name of the driver. |
| 2 | Full name | Enter the driver's full name. |
| 3 | Partner code | Driver code used for internal management and identification. |
| 4 | In-house driver? | Whether the driver is in-house or outsourced. |
| 5 | Owner | Required if the driver is outsourced. |
| 6 | Address | **Required.** Address of the driver. |
| 7 | Position | Position of the driver. |
| 8 | Mobile | **Required.** Mobile number of the driver. |

![](/uploads/0f3a64d41b83e1e02496640c.png)

**Personal information [2]**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | Date of birth | Enter the driver's date of birth. |
| 10 | Bank account | Enter the driver's bank account number. |
| 11 | Bank | Enter the name of the bank for that account. |
| 12 | Emergency contact | Enter the name of the driver's emergency contact. |
| 13 | Emergency contact phone | Enter the phone number of the driver's emergency contact. |
| 14 | ID card number | **Required.** The driver's national ID card number. |
| 15 | Date of issue | Date the ID card was issued. |
| 16 | Place of issue | Place the ID card was issued. |
| 17 | Licence class | The driver's licence class. |
| 18 | Licence number | The driver's licence number. |
| 19 | Licence validity | Validity period of the driver's licence. |

![](/uploads/afffc14b0682c6f8487af900.png)

**Driver profile information [3]**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 20 | Document name | Name of the document in the driver's profile. |
| 21 | Required | Whether the document is mandatory. |
| 22 | Attachment | The attached document; required when **Required** = true. |
| 23 | Description | Enter a description. |

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/bafc0fa9f753fdde9fbc982b.png)

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/6d2d70501b04869a6c809b03.png)

## Related actions

- [Creating driver leave](/d/driver-leave-management#creating-driver-leave-for-dispatchers)
- [Viewing driver leave](/d/driver-leave-management#driver-leave-management-menu)

sections.title: Driver profile template configuration
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Partners > Driver documents

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use the path above to open the screen where you create a driver profile.

![](/uploads/8bf0f682cadcbbf74ba80cdd.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a driver profile.

![](/uploads/7b57d3d148e724f9706842ca.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system opens the form view. Enter the driver profile information.

![](/uploads/fc6080a373ea39ce501586e3.png)

### Step 3

Click **SAVE** to save what you have entered.

![](/uploads/41bd589d996851e3a25044fd.png)

## Fields to pay attention to

**General information**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Driver profile name | Enter the name of the driver profile. |
| 2 | Driver category | The profile applies to an **In-house driver** or an **Outsourced driver**. |

**Documents to add**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | Document name | Select the document type to add. The document list is configured under Documents. |
| 4 | Required | Whether this document is required when creating a driver. |
| 5 | Description | Enter a description. |

**Documents required to run a trip**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6 | Document name | Select the document type to add. The document list is configured under Documents. |
| 7 | Description | Enter a description. |

## Result

The record after it has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/a1b9c8d7fc3a4276bf7267fb.png)
